title: the-inference-sole-path-admits-the-bus-client
intention: The inference sole-path rule admits cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, whose socket import opens only the local AF_UNIX bus socket, as a second allowed importer at each of its three seats (build_inspector's _SOLE_PATH, inference_domain's test_host.py, import_sieve's real-corpus tooth), so the rule stops redding a client that reaches an established device through the bus, while every other dialer, including any other bus_client file, stays caught.
why: bus_client's PROVED crossing (ticket 0524116d3fd4) is refused by sole_path_holds, and test_host.py and test_import_sieve.py stand red repo-wide, because remote.py imports socket to speak <home>/bus.sock. Akien answered CairnCommons/questions/open-10941757e6b7.json on 2026-10-04: the rule exists so nobody goes around an established device, the socket mesh is only the mechanism, 'I'll go with your yes'. A deterministic red that carries his answer gets built, not left standing.
traces_to: CairnCommons/questions/open-10941757e6b7.json (answered); Law 9 and the rule 'a deterministic red is fixed, or it carries a decision from Akien'; Law 5 (the charter's falsifier (6) and the code must not contradict); RULE 1 (span recorded: the rule is already restated in three components, and the one-declaration fix is blocked by build_inspector's unreachable rule)
how: Widen 'only' to a tuple at each of the three seats, each with a comment citing open-10941757e6b7. Add one question-kind entry per seat to cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json. Append the admission to inference_domain's charter falsifier (6). Add two proofs: one in inference_domain over its own rule, one in build_inspector over sole_path_holds.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) test_host._SOLE_PATH over the real repo catches nothing; (2) the same rule over a planted graph catches socket in cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py and in skills/rogue/probe.py, spares cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py and cairn/devices/inference_domain/host.py, and every refusal names cairn/devices/inference_domain/; (3) inference_domain's charter falsifier (6) names open-10941757e6b7 and that question is resolved; (4) build_inspector's sole_path_holds over the real bus_client row (comp_dir cairn/tools/bus_client) returns []; (5) sole_path_holds over a seeded root where bus_client/remote.py and bus_client/other.py both import socket returns exactly one finding, naming other.py. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if all of bus_client is admitted, or if the admission stands without the question resolving. Horizon: PROVED, then 0524116d3fd4's PROVED crossing is no longer refused by sole_path_holds, and test_import_sieve.py and test_host.py reseal green.
watchme: none, because the exemptions machine's set (cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json) is already the watched roster of every site where a check declines to run, and this ticket adds its three entries there
children: none, because the change is one tuple at each of three seats, three exemption entries, one charter sentence and two proofs

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py change _SOLE_PATH's "only" from "inference_domain/" to the tuple ("inference_domain/", "bus_client/remote.py"), and add above the dict a comment: '# "only" is a tuple since 2026-10-04 (ticket f5a344e6c629): bus_client/remote.py imports socket only for the local AF_UNIX bus socket, admitted by Akien's answer to CairnCommons/questions/open-10941757e6b7.json. Prefixes are relative to the graphed root (comp_dir.parent), so a tool reads as bus_client/<file>.' Nothing else in inspector.py changes.

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py change _SOLE_PATH's "only" from "cairn/devices/inference_domain/" to ("cairn/devices/inference_domain/", "cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py") with a one-line comment citing open-10941757e6b7 and ticket f5a344e6c629. The planted tooth (test_the_sole_path_tooth_reds_on_a_planted_dialer) is unchanged.

D3: SETTLED: in cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_import_sieve.py change ONLY the inference rule inside test_sole_path_is_clean_on_the_real_corpus_for_both_domains: "only": ("cairn/devices/inference_domain/", "cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py"), with a one-line comment citing open-10941757e6b7. test_sole_path_catches_a_second_door (planted) and the db rule stay as they are. sieve.py does not change: startswith already takes a tuple, and the refusal's tuple repr still contains 'cairn/devices/inference_domain/'.

D4: SETTLED: append three entries to the "exemptions" list of cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json, each with kind "sieve-scope", justification_kind "question", evidence "open-10941757e6b7": id "inference-sole-path-admits-bus-client-inspector", path "cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py", symbol "\"bus_client/remote.py\""; id "inference-sole-path-admits-bus-client-host-proof", path "cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py", symbol "\"cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py\""; id "inference-sole-path-admits-bus-client-sieve-proof", path "cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_import_sieve.py", symbol "\"cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py\"". Each description: 'the inference sole-path rule's "only" admits cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, whose socket opens only the local AF_UNIX bus socket (ticket f5a344e6c629)'. Edit with a short Python json load/dump (indent 1, ensure_ascii True, matching the file).

D5: SETTLED: inference_domain's charter (cairn/devices/inference_domain/intention+why.json) falsifier clause (6): insert, immediately before '; (7)', the sentence ' Admitted 2026-10-04 by Akien's answer to CairnCommons/questions/open-10941757e6b7.json (ticket f5a344e6c629): cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, whose socket opens only the local AF_UNIX bus socket; any other importer still reds.' Written through `cairn artifact write <path> --verb cast --why '...' --from <file>`, then recompile_gate.sh.

D6: SETTLED: two new proofs, each printing '  ok   <tooth>' / '  FAIL <tooth>: ...' then GREEN/RED like cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_declares_its_own_time_limit.py, teeth imported inside bodies. (a) cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_the_bus_client_is_admitted_to_the_sole_path.py, PROVES {"f5a344e6c629": {"1": "test_the_real_repo_has_one_door", "2": "test_a_planted_dialer_is_still_caught", "3": "test_the_charter_names_the_answer"}}: tooth 1 loads test_host.py by importlib.util.spec_from_file_location and asserts sieve.catches(sieve.import_graph(repo), test_host._SOLE_PATH) == []; tooth 2 builds a planted graph (25 filler files importing json, plus cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py and skills/rogue/probe.py importing socket, and cairn/devices/inference_domain/host.py importing urllib.request) and asserts exactly two catches, for bus_client.py and skills/rogue/probe.py, each containing 'cairn/devices/inference_domain/'; tooth 3 asserts the charter's falsifier contains 'open-10941757e6b7' and that CairnCommons/questions/open-10941757e6b7.json (repo parent / CairnCommons) has resolved true. (b) cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_the_inspector_admits_the_bus_client.py, PROVES {"f5a344e6c629": {"4": "test_the_real_bus_client_row_is_clean", "5": "test_a_second_bus_client_dialer_is_caught"}}: tooth 4 calls inspector.sole_path_holds({"component": "bus_client"}, repo/cairn/tools/bus_client) and asserts []; tooth 5 seeds scratch_dir root with bus_client/remote.py and bus_client/other.py ('import socket') plus 25 filler modules, calls sole_path_holds({"component": "bus_client"}, root/bus_client) and asserts exactly one finding whose 'about' contains 'other.py'.
